interpretation: The documents are design inputs. Code, receipts, paper results and preserved failures are the current-state authority.
objective: Move the V3 and F2 design into repeatable Data-Signal-TargetPortfolio-Orders-BrokerAdapter-Fill-CashPosition slices with research-only execution.

guardrails.weekend_rule: Do not fabricate a 2026-10-26 close before the session closes.

team_model.parallelism: Two substantive writers plus root integration; reviewers use independent fixtures/oracles.
team_model.redundancy_rule: Redundancy is only for PIT timing, unit/period semantics, cash/lot conservation, and duplicate-action recovery.
team_model.no_duplicate_work: Do not restart a terminal package without changed code, input snapshot or resource design.

waves.name: baseline_freeze
waves.acceptance: All downstream work references exact snapshot, cost model, benchmark binding and execution gate.

waves.name: next_close_D0_D1
deliverables: fixed plus registered candidate same-day target/quote inputs
waves.acceptance: One idempotent command after the 2026-10-26 close; fixed and candidates use the same Engine/Ledger, exact cost/benchmark IDs, and execution_admitted=false.
waves.result: The post-close coordinator now advances the registered fixed_daily head before invoking the next-close contract; incomplete source packages stop with a waiting receipt, while complete same-day inputs reach D0/D1 using the pinned calendar and committed fixed target.

waves.name: F2_single_event_factor_slice
deliverables: standard fact/period/unit/available_at contract or concrete blocked receipt
factor-to-shared-account bridge when PIT gates pass
waves.acceptance: One event reaches Signal→Target Portfolio→Orders→Fill→Cash/Position only when publication/retrieval/as-of/revision and units/period gates pass; otherwise BLOCKED_DATA with no task/replay.
waves.result: The alternate public financial source now maps 18 historical report rows into the existing F2 sidecar and bridge; 0 rows are PIT-safe and 0 facts are admitted because retrieval/as-of, field timing, units and issuer scope remain unproven.

waves.name: candidate_same_snapshot_comparison
deliverables: trend/momentum, mature factor, Alpha158/LightGBM candidate outputs on one pinned snapshot
waves.acceptance: No parameter retuning to rescue a result; each candidate has target/order/account evidence or an explicit stop/coverage block.
waves.result: Same-snapshot comparison, decision-bound routing and candidate paper paths are wired. Shortline LR and LGBM saved targets now each reach the shared research-only route on their own terminal days; separate-gate and incomplete-window limits remain explicit.

waves.name: paper_continuity_and_readonly_channel
deliverables: THS read-only evidence when externally authorized
waves.acceptance: Paper state is recoverable and traceable; no live login, prefill submission, order, cancel or transfer.
waves.result: Joint paper packages emit a target-bound THS read-only reference, and the explicit readback comparator now preserves verified, mismatch-stop and incomplete-stop outcomes without client or Ledger actions.

waves.name: release_decision
waves.acceptance: Only verified data, research and channel states are reported separately; execution gate remains closed.

2026-10-26 daily paper run must wait for the actual close.
